what: Claims this repository published and then withdrew. Read by research_grade.py: a withdrawn wording may appear anywhere only if its id is cited within `window` lines. Empty until 2026-11-09, when three were recorded: SE-R1 (exp5/exp6's failure shape, superseded by exp7's bug fix), SE-R2 (a bar for every experiment) and SE-R3 (what sets the ~1.9x ratio). SE-R4 recorded 2026-11-20 (five sentences about exp18).

retractions.claim: That exp5/exp6's three designs failed the same way: a dead third neuron that never gets the early wins it needs, so one pattern stays unclaimed.
verbatim: a "dead" third neuron that never gets the early wins it needs, so one pattern stays unclaimed
retractions.truth: One seed (5) on code that kept both STDP Synapses in a list, so Brian2's magic run() dropped noise->out (warned on every run). Built explicitly (exp7), every neuron fires and one neuron per pattern holds on most of seeds 1-8; the failure is the 2x weight-separation bar, unmet on all eight (about 1.5-1.9x).

retractions.claim: That every experiment here had its pass/fail bar declared before it ran.
verbatim: Each one was written with its **pass/fail bar declared before it ran**
with the pass/fail bar declared before each run
retractions.truth: exp1 and exp2 declare no bar; they are demonstrations. exp3 and exp5-exp12 each declare one.

retractions.claim: That the ~1.9x shared by three inhibition topologies was a ceiling on learning, so the next change belonged in the plasticity rule (the LTP threshold).
verbatim:
The one named redesign still unrun is the LTP threshold / lower background rate -- a change to
the PLASTICITY rule, which is where the three converging results now point.
retractions.truth: The ratio stands as measured, and per-output normalisation leaves it unchanged at each rescaling step (exp8's reasoning). What it measures is confounded: exp14-16 show the score is 1.07 at t = 0 before any learning, its rise is in the burst synapses, and its denominator (inputs 60-99) holds burst synapses that never fire. All three topologies share the score; only the direct-inhibition network was re-tested, where burst-synapse selectivity within inputs 0-59, chosen after exp16, passed a pre-registered test on new seeds 9-16 (exp17).
retractions.refuted_by: exp14-exp17, 2026-11-09 (prereg/ and the exp14-17 logs in this repository).
patterns: where the three converging\s+results now point

retractions.claim: That in exp18 the ratio held by the arithmetic of normalisation, that shrinking the noise synapses cannot move it, that chance-coincidence potentiation is ruled out as what holds it, and that the claimed synapses' lag reads as pinning by their own timing.
verbatim: so the top and bottom of the ratio rose together
So any change that only moves the noise synapses leaves the ratio where it was.

The diagnosis in exp11's own docstring, that spurious noise LTP holds the ratio near 1.9x,
   does not survive.

as if the claimed synapses were pinned by their own timing rather
   than by the budget.
exp18 ruled out the noise synapses as what holds the published ratio
retractions.truth: Had the claimed burst synapses followed the budget like the silent ones (which only normalisation moves, +18.4%), the mean ratio would have been 1.997, not 1.840 (exp18_posthoc_out.txt); they rose 6.9%. The top and bottom of the ratio stayed where they were. The gate also blocked 4.5% of the claimed synapses' own potentiation, so exp18 cannot say whether chance-coincidence potentiation holds the ratio, nor separate the volley-timing reading of the lag from the gate's own trimming. Saturation is excluded (largest claimed weight 1.38 of 2.0).
retractions.refuted_by: An outside read of spiking-experiments#12 (Gemini, signed out, 2026-11-20) and the post hoc check it led to, exp18_posthoc.py, the same day.
